integrity: The semantic proof is symbolic. A standalone exhaustive C++ checker verifies the complement duality and exact counts for every set-family on up to four labeled points, totaling 2,281,512 exact assertions/comparisons.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns fixed finite proposition sets and lax team semantics; Yang’s strict semantics is explicitly outside the scope.
The exact class numbers reduce to the classical Moore-family numbers, so no new large-n enumeration algorithm is claimed.
The bridge is a short synthesis of published expressive completeness and classical closure-system duality; uncatalogued folklore under different terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: Moore-family semantic quotient of union-closed team logics
